newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Justice takes time for nervous Vietnam gangster.
newsitem.headline: Justice takes time for nervous Vietnam gangster.

text.p: A guilt-plagued gangster turned himself in after waiting in vain overnight outside a Ho Chi Minh City jail for someone to arrest him.
Local newspapers said Luong Van "Hitler" Son arrived at the Chi Hoa prison and police compound with his wife and one-year-old child on Monday night to confess involvement in a theft.
But police, who had been searching for him for a month, refused to arrest him until the following morning.
"How were we supposed to recognise him? We hadn't seen much of him," a local police official told Reuters by phone.
Son, who acquired his nickname because of an ugly scar under his nose, told reporters he had lost his nerve.
"I knew the police had been looking for me," they quoted him as saying. "But I was so frightened I got nervous every time a dog barked or chicken squawked."
